description: Zero-tolerance gate on startup migrations, read by scripts/verify-startup-migrations.mjs from the migrations block of /api/health/db. CI gates the whole backend suite on the startup step, and that step used to succeed whether or not any migration in it had failed, so a broken migration ran the suite against a partly applied schema. The baseline began at 11 failures observed on a fresh database; all 11 were fixed, so the ceiling is now 0 and ANY startup migration failure fails the build. It may only fall, which means it may not rise again.

classes.resolved-seed-foreign-key: Nine seed INSERTs into agent_declarant_mappings and ledger_accounts pinned company_id values that do not exist on a fresh database. Each is now a guarded SELECT that checks both the company and the referenced ledger account exist, so they no-op on an empty database and still seed once the target company is created.
classes.resolved-stale-schema: Two foreign keys targeted schema that no longer exists: supplier_containers (the table is defined neither in startup-schema nor in shared/schema) and bales.erp_location_id (only factory_bales carries that column now). Both statements are kept and guarded on the object existing rather than deleted, so a long-lived database that still has them still gains the key.

observedOn: Fresh database provisioned with drizzle-kit push, matching the CI sequence in .github/workflows/ci.yml. Verified at 0 failures after the Phase B fixes.
